newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 2 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 2 PM.

text.p: * The two Chambers of the newly-elected parliament met in their first session after November 3 election.

* Parliamentary debates should take place in a decent, constructive and transparent environment in order to achieve a full reconciliation, Valentin Gabrielescu, a National Peasant Party senator, said in his opening speech.
* The Senate parliamentary groups were formed and their leaders elected.
* Outgoing President Ion Iliescu is head of the Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) parliamentary group.
* Until the lower house Standing Bureau is elected, debates are led by the doyen from the Social Democratic Party.
* Ion Diaconescu was elected leader of the National Peasant-Civic Ecologist parliamentary group.
* The Validation Commission will study for four days all the MP's files and present its report next week.
* The Constitutional Court validated the election of Emil Constantinescu as new Romanian president.

* Constantinescu said he would lead the country through hard times. He said he was aware that most Romanians were impoverished and a series of emergency measures was needed to improve living standards. --Bucharest Newsroom +401 312-0264
